verdict.rationale: Shopify POS processes in-person card payments, so payout timing and accelerated (next-day or instant) payouts are a fair question for it. The evidence pack covers checkout, Tap to Pay, inventory, staff and extensions, but never mentions payout schedules, payout visibility, or faster payouts. With no evidence for an applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see when each payout lands and speed it up (next-day or instant) when I need the cash
